question: Add a new method CompactWithDeletionMarkers(ctx context.Context, markers []DeletionMark) error to the Syncer in thanos/pkg/compact. Mimir's compactor embeds Thanos Syncer for multi-tenant block lifecycle management. This new method enables deletion-mark-aware compaction.

mimir.details: Mimir has its own metaSyncer (pkg/compactor/bucket_compactor.go:53) modeled after Thanos Syncer (provenance comment at line 2 references github.com/thanos-io/thanos/pkg/compact/compact.go). Mimir's metaSyncer has SyncMetas, Metas, and GarbageCollect methods mirroring Thanos Syncer. Adding CompactWithDeletionMarkers to Thanos Syncer would enable Mimir to adopt or mirror this method for deletion-mark-aware compaction in its multi-tenant compactor flow.
mimir.method_createMetaSyncerForUser: Creates per-tenant metaSyncer instances for multi-tenant block lifecycle management

bucket_compactor_usage.flow: BucketCompactor.Compact() calls sy.SyncMetas() -> sy.GarbageCollect() -> grouper.Groups(sy.Metas()) -> group.Compact(). The new CompactWithDeletionMarkers method would be called after SyncMetas to filter out deletion-marked blocks before grouping and compaction.
